definition: Margin required to cover the risk because of the price fluctuations occurred on the unsettled exposures towards central counterparty.

FinancialInstrumentIdentification.name: Financial Instrument Identification
FinancialInstrumentIdentification.definition: Provides details about the security identification.

TotalVariationMargin.name: Total Variation Margin
TotalVariationMargin.definition: Margin required to cover the risk because of the price fluctuations occurred on the unsettled exposures towards the central counterparty.

TotalMarkToMarket.name: Total Mark To Market
TotalMarkToMarket.definition: Net unrealised profit or loss on the value of the netted, gross and failing positions.

MarkToMarketNetted.name: Mark To Market Netted
MarkToMarketNetted.definition: Unrealised net loss calculated at the participant portfolio level.

MarkToMarketGross.name: Mark To Market Gross
MarkToMarketGross.definition: Unrealised net loss calculated in that market/boundary.

MarkToMarketFails.name: Mark To Market Fails
MarkToMarketFails.definition: Sum of the unrealised loss without taking profit into consideration.

FailsHaircut.name: Fails Haircut
FailsHaircut.definition: Haircut applied to the absolute value of the participants net positions. Calculation depends on a participants credit rating.
